     3→## Project Overview
     4→
     5→RustRide is an open-source, self-hosted indoor cycling training application built in Rust. It provides BLE sensor connectivity (smart trainers, power meters, HR monitors), structured workout execution with ERG mode control, real-time metrics display, ride recording, and export to standard formats (.fit, .tcx).
     6→
     7→## Technology Stack
     8→

    71→
    72→## Key Modules
    73→
    74→### sensors/
    75→BLE sensor discovery and connection using btleplug. Supports:
    76→- FTMS (Fitness Machine Service) for smart trainers
    77→- Cycling Power Service for power meters
    78→- Heart Rate Service for HR monitors
    79→
    80→### workouts/
    81→Workout file parsing (.zwo, .mrc) and execution engine. Manages:
    82→- Workout state machine (start, pause, resume, skip)
    83→- ERG mode power target calculations
    84→- Interval timing and transitions
    85→
    86→### recording/
    87→Ride data capture and export. Features:
    88→- 1-second sample recording
    89→- Auto-save for crash recovery (30-second intervals)
    90→- Export to TCX, FIT, GPX, CSV formats
    91→
    92→### metrics/
    93→Training metric calculations:
    94→- Normalized Power (NP)
    95→- Training Stress Score (TSS)
    96→- Intensity Factor (IF)
    97→- Power and HR zone calculations
    98→
    99→### storage/
   100→Data persistence:
   101→- SQLite for rides, workouts, sensors
   102→- TOML for user configuration
   103→- Auto-migrations on startup
   104→
   105→## Development Commands
   106→
   107→```bash
   108→# Build
   109→cargo build              # Debug build
   110→cargo build --release    # Release build
   111→
   112→# Test

   114→cargo test sensors       # Test specific module
   115→
   116→# Run

   121→cargo fmt                # Format code

   123→```

   126→
   127→### Thread Communication
   128→- Use `crossbeam::channel` for sensor data (BLE → UI)
   129→- Use `Arc<Mutex<T>>` for shared state (ride samples)
   130→- Call `ctx.request_repaint()` from background threads to wake UI
   131→
   132→### BLE Protocol
   133→- FTMS Control Point writes for ERG mode: `[0x05, watts_lo, watts_hi]`
   134→- Always request control (`[0x00]`) before setting targets
   135→- Handle automatic reconnection on signal loss
   136→
   137→### Metrics Calculations
   138→- Normalized Power: 30s rolling average → 4th power → mean → 4th root
   139→- TSS = (hours × IF²) × 100
   140→- Filter power spikes > 2000W as noise

   142→## Configuration Locations

   145→- **macOS**: `~/Library/Application Support/rustride/`
   146→- **Linux**: `~/.config/rustride/` (config), `~/.local/share/rustride/` (data)

   154→- Enter/Space for button activation
   155→- Escape to close modals

   157→- Ctrl+M for screen reader metrics announcement
   158→
   159→### Visual Accessibility

   161→- Colorblind-safe palettes (deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia)
   162→- System theme detection and follow (dark/light)
   163→- Minimum 44x44px touch targets

   165→### Screen Reader Support
   166→- AccessKit integration (NVDA, VoiceOver, Orca)
   167→- Live regions for interval changes
   168→- Immediate alert announcements

   171→### Voice Control (optional)
   172→Enable with `--features voice-control`:
   173→- Commands: start, pause, resume, end, skip
   174→- Increase/decrease power targets
   175→- Status announcements
   176→
   177→### Touch/Gesture Support

   188→- P3: Record and export ride data
